senses.gloss: (διαδοχή, v. דייתיכוס) relays, guards at stations. [Popular adaptation דרכ׳, as if fr. דֶּרֶךְ.] Yoma VI, 8 (68ᵇ) דיד׳ Y. ed. (Mish. דִּרְכָאוֹת; Bab. ed. דִּירְכָ׳, Ms. M. דִּיתְּכָ׳, Ms. L. דוד׳, דיד׳; Mish. Nap. דִּירְכָיוֹת, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 דורכיות היו לו Pharaoh had guards at stations (communicating with one another).—
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16">Yalk. ib. 16</cite> [read:] <he>הרבה להן בריצה והרבה להן בדְיָידוֹכִין</he> he increased for them the speed (of the mail bearers), and the number of mail stations.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>דורכ׳ עם דורניאות וכ׳</he> postmen carrying gifts will be numerous &c.
